name: 2021-2c-recuperatorio-parcial1
title: SmartBuilding: team mood refactoring
description: The SmartBuilding construction-teams model now lets a simple team have a mood (#Normal, #MuyBueno, #Malo) that halves or doubles its construction time, implemented with ifs on a symbol and validated against a literal list. The student must replace those ifs with polymorphism (mood objects) and remove the duplicated code from the 25 tests, keeping them green.

design.notes: The ifs are small and local (a mood symbol in EquipoSimple>>tiempoEnConstruir: plus a class-side includes: check and a redundant second initializer), so the interesting part is deciding what the mood objects look like, how the invalid-mood test survives when symbols disappear, and how to remove duplication from 25 tests that each rebuild teams, capacities, prices and Aconcagua areas inline; the rest of the model (composite teams, price and capacity strategies) is already well designed and must not be broken.
